finding.text: The one reader this task fixed is missing from the readers table: `core/Item/doc/line-format.md:54-70` has no row for `Servex/CloseLoop.js` `lines` (`LineKey.deep`, tested in `line-readers.test.mjs`), and it doesn't say that `StaleClose` is now tested too. Add the row, so the table stays the complete list of readers.

`core/Item/readme.md:88` still says every reader reads both spellings "so it can be switched on". The new `line-format.md` "Why it is still off" paragraph and `core/doc/status.md` now say the switch is blocked by 10 core test files. Update the readme line to match and link that paragraph.

A fresh agent can't pick up the remaining work from this task folder. `session.jsonl` has 6 lines: no outcome, no `complete`, and no record of the 3-line report to vscode-mastermind. The next step (update the bare-spelling expectations in the 10 test files, then set `Store.marked_lines = true` again) is written only as prose in `line-format.md`. File it as a task on the session, and land this one with an outcome that says the switch was tried (8e7e88f98), reverted (aa4a43681), and why.

Step 3 asked for the full suite, `node core/Test/run-all.mjs` plus `--browser`. Nothing in the diff or the log records a run with the switch off, or a browser run. Only the `ReplayCompare` 4068/4068 number and the 10 failing files are stated. Say which suites passed.

Step 2 said to commit the failing test before the fix. The CloseLoop test and its fix landed together in 8d285d7b4. The 8 original readers were done this way earlier (771c48495, then ee6e2bb8b), so only the last reader skipped the red step.

`core/doc/status.md:29` now has two brackets back to back: "(blocked only by 10 test files … listed in the doc below) (one line in `Store.js`; steps: …)". Join them into one sentence. "Real properties, not pseudo properties" is also left unexplained there and in `line-format.md:5`. The sentence after it does the explaining, so the phrase could go.

Neither run in `core/Test/run-all.jsonl` (21:11:57 and 21:15:33) was made with the switch off: both ended before the revert `aa4a43681` landed at 21:15:45, and neither has a `browser` block. Step 3's "full suite plus `--browser`" is still unproven for the state that merges. Off, `line-readers.test.mjs` passes (8/8 tests, re-run by this review in the worktree).

The diff carries test-run noise from other work: 450 lines in `core/Test/results.jsonl`, the `run-all.jsonl` lines, a second `failures.jsonl` "gone" row in `core/Item/files.jsonl:57` and `core/Test/files.jsonl:48-49`, and `V1Bubbles.js` and `V1Bubbles.test.mjs` indexed in `core/Session/Chat/files.jsonl`, which this task didn't make. Harmless, but it buries the real 6-file change.

The task hasn't landed yet: this folder's `session.jsonl` has no outcome or `complete` line. The follow-up is now filed (task `foxtdl3s`: "Update the 10 core test files … then set Store.marked_lines = true"), so a fresh agent can continue. The landing outcome should say the switch was tried (`8e7e88f98`), reverted (`aa4a43681`) and why, and that Servex and the dev server need a restart (`Servex/CloseLoop.js` changed).

`core/Item/doc/line-format.md:5` still opens with "real properties, not pseudo properties", which a new reader can't parse. The next sentence explains it; `status.md:29` now explains it in brackets. The phrase could go.
